integrity: Original integral derivations, exact symbolic cross-checks and mathematical proof are included; no external independence or priority certification is asserted.
limitations: Requires known perimeter and strictly positive triangle area. Distances arise from independent uniform-arclength boundary endpoints rather than invariant random-line chords. Inversion of the fourth-moment shape invariant is ill-conditioned as area tends to zero. The older random-chord literature was not exhaustively accessible; independent validation is outstanding.
title: Perimeter and two even boundary-chord moments reconstruct every Euclidean triangle
